title: Opencode bros BLACKBOX.md @-imports loading
wanted_capability: Opencode bros honor the rendered BLACKBOX.md guidance. Investigate whether opencode chases `@/path/...` AGENTS.md @-imports; if not, render to opencode's expected location too.
notes: Opencode bros (glm, deepseek) have access to bbox MCP tools per `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` but their behavioral default is `grep`/`read`. The rendered guidance in `~/.claude-shared/BLACKBOX.md` reaches them only if opencode honors AGENTS.md @-imports.
